messages:
sam: quick ping — crawler flagged a 404 on the runtime guide images section. link: https://kb.redwood.dev/runtime/overview#images :eyes:
jen: thanks — which exact asset is 404? I can take a look if unclaimed.
maria: heads up — I own the runtime text, not the CDN images, but I can coordinate. @ryan do you own the rehost/redirect workflow? :wave:
sam: path is /assets/runtime/setup-diagram.png. crawler log snippet: `GET /assets/runtime/setup-diagram.png -> 404`
ryan: not the primary owner, but I can add a redirect if we have the original. do we have the source in the media repo (team-assets/runtime)?
sam: I grabbed a local copy and started a PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/589. quick sed I used locally: `git grep -l 'setup-diagram.png' | xargs sed -i 's|/assets/runtime/|/cdn-cgi/imaged/|g'` — will switch to canonical path if you prefer.
jen: prefer canonical CDN path. can you change it to `/cdn/images/runtime/setup-diagram.png` in the PR? pinging @docs-bot to tag owner and create a ticket. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: automatic: link-scan found 1 broken asset in docs/runtime. owner suggestion: mariadev. Created ticket DOCS-412 and added triage label.
maria: I'll claim DOCS-412 and coordinate with infra for a permanent rehost. @sam please update the PR to point at `/cdn/images/runtime/setup-diagram.png` instead of the temp path. thanks for the PR!
sam: will update PR tonight. quick question — should infra also add a 301 from old path to new for one week after deploy? @ryan
ryan: yep, I'll add a 301 redirect and mark it for 7 days in the ticket. will include TTL details.
jen: summarizing: maria owns, sam updates PR to canonical CDN path, ryan adds temporary redirect. closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: short coordination about a 404 image in runtime guide: sam found broken asset, created WIP PR, maria claims ownership and will coordinate rehost, ryan will add redirect, docs-bot created ticket DOCS-412
